_about: Generic OBD-II diagnostic trouble code (DTC) lookup for the SkewAi AI layer. Only generic, widely published SAE J2012-style meanings that the author is confident of are listed. No manufacturer-specific meanings. Codes not listed resolve to 'unknown code' and have no effect. safety: 'safety' = fault in a safety-critical system (may raise case severity to the pack's safety-system level, never lower); 'elevated' = drivability/component fault shown as evidence only; neither ever lowers severity. There is NO public dataset linking DTCs to recalls, so no accuracy or recall-backtest claim is made for this table.
_source: Author knowledge of SAE J2012 / ISO 15031-6 generic code structure and commonly published generic definitions; not copied from the standard. confidence: 'high' = standard generic definition; 'medium' = widely published but definitions may vary by manufacturer.

ranges.meaning: Cylinder N misfire detected (N = last two digits)
Wheel speed sensor circuit (C0035 LF, C0040 RF, C0045 LR, C0050 RR): ABS / brake system input
Lost communication with anti-lock brake system (ABS) control module
Lost communication with steering angle sensor module
Lost communication with power steering control module
Lost communication with restraints control module

excluded_on_purpose: C04xx / C0455 steering codes: meanings vary by manufacturer, not confident enough to map
